quadriceps__example.text: Press through your front foot and feel the front of your thigh working.

hamstrings__example.text: Bend your knees a little to soften the back of your thighs.

glutes__example.text: Squeeze your seat gently to support your lower back.

gluteus-medius__example.text: Keep your front knee tracking over your toes; feel the side of your hip switch on.

hip-adductors__example.text: Let your inner thighs open as you sink into the pose.

hip-flexors__example.text: Reach your back leg long to stretch the front of your hip.

piriformis__example.text: You should feel this deep in your outer hip, not in your knee.

calves__plain.text: the back of your lower legs

calves__example.text: Pedal your feet to wake up your calves.

deltoids__example.text: Reach through your fingertips and let your shoulders stay soft.

triceps__plain.text: the back of your upper arms

triceps__example.text: Straighten your arms without locking your elbows.

abdominals__example.text: Draw your belly in gently to support your spine.

spine__example.text: Lengthen through your spine from your tailbone to the crown of your head.

sacrum__plain.text: the flat bone at the base of your spine

sacrum__example.text: Let the base of your spine feel heavy toward the floor.

pelvis__example.text: Keep your hips level, like a bowl of water you don’t want to spill.

sit-bones__example.text: Lift your sitting bones up toward the ceiling.

hips__example.text: Open your hips to the side wall.

knees__example.text: Bend your front knee so it stacks over your ankle.

ankles__example.text: Stack your knee over your ankle, not past it.

wrists__example.text: If your wrists complain, come down onto your forearms.

heels__example.text: Reach your heels toward the floor; they don’t have to touch.

crown__example.text: Lengthen through the crown of your head.

root-down__example.text: Root down through the outer edge of your back foot.

shoulders__example.text: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.

tailbone__example.text: Let your tailbone drop toward your heels.

lengthen__example.text: Lengthen through the crown of your head.

soften__example.text: Soften your jaw and the space between your eyebrows.

stack__example.text: Stack your knee over your ankle.

release__example.text: Release your head and let it hang heavy.

gaze__example.text: Gaze softly over your front fingertips.

tuck__example.text: Tuck your toes and lift your hips.

find-your-edge__example.text: Find your edge: enough to feel it, not so much that you tense against it.

toward__example.text: Reach your heels toward the floor.

away-from__example.text: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.

in-line-with__example.text: Keep your front heel in line with the arch of your back foot.

over__example.text: Bring your shoulders over your wrists.

breathe__example.text: Breathe into the back of your body.

on-your-next-exhale__example.text: On your next exhale, slowly come out of the pose.

sternocleidomastoid__plain.text: the long muscle at the side of your neck

trapezius__plain.text: the top of your shoulders and upper back

levator-scapulae__plain.text: the muscle that lifts your shoulder blade

rhomboids__plain.text: the muscles between your shoulder blades

rotator-cuff__plain.text: the small muscles that hold your shoulder in its socket

teres-major__plain.text: the muscle under your armpit at the back

pectoralis-minor__plain.text: the small muscle under your chest

serratus-anterior__plain.text: the muscle along the side of your ribs

latissimus-dorsi__plain.text: the big muscles of your mid back

erector-spinae__plain.text: the long muscles along your spine

quadratus-lumborum__plain.text: the deep muscle of your lower back and waist

biceps-brachii__plain.text: the front of your upper arms

triceps-brachii__plain.text: the back of your upper arms

internal-oblique__plain.text: the deeper layer of your waist

transversus-abdominis__plain.text: your deep belly, like a corset

diaphragm__plain.text: your breathing muscle, under your ribs

tensor-fasciae-latae__plain.text: the muscle at the outer front of your hip

gluteus-minimus__plain.text: the small deep muscle of your outer hip

deep-rotators__plain.text: the small muscles deep in your hip

sartorius__plain.text: the long strap muscle across your thigh

it-band__plain.text: the thick band down the outside of your thigh

tibialis-posterior__plain.text: the deep muscle that holds up your arch

fibularis-longus__plain.text: the outside of your lower leg

hip-points__plain.text: the bony points at the front of your hips

pubic-bone__plain.text: the bone at the front of your pelvis

abduction__plain.text: lift out to the side, widen

pronation-supination__plain.text: turn your palm down / turn your palm up

protraction-retraction__plain.text: spread your shoulder blades / squeeze your shoulder blades

pelvic-tilt__plain.text: tip your pelvis forward / tuck your tailbone

sternocleidomastoid__cue-1.text: Let your head be heavy; you don’t need to hold it up with your neck.

trapezius__cue-1.text: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.

trapezius__cue-2.text: Slide your shoulder blades down your back.

levator-scapulae__cue-2.text: Keep your shoulder blades heavy as you reach up.

rhomboids__cue-1.text: Draw your shoulder blades toward each other and lift your chest.

deltoids__cue-1.text: Reach out through your fingertips; let the shoulders stay soft while the arms work.

rotator-cuff__cue-1.text: Rotate your upper arms outward so the shoulders feel wide.

teres-major__cue-1.text: Lift your armpits toward the ceiling in Downward Dog.

pectoralis-major__cue-1.text: Open your chest toward the ceiling.

pectoralis-minor__cue-2.text: Lift the front of your shoulders away from the floor.

serratus-anterior__cue-1.text: Push the floor away and feel your upper back broaden.

deltoids__cue-2.text: In Warrior II, keep the arms at shoulder height, strong to the fingertips.

pectoralis-major__cue-3.text: Lower to Chaturanga with your chest, not your chin.

rectus-abdominis__cue-2.text: In Boat, lift your chest and keep the belly firm, not hard.

transversus-abdominis__cue-2.text: Engage uddiyana bandha: lift and draw in just below the navel.

iliopsoas__cue-3.text: Tuck your tailbone slightly to lengthen the front of your hips.

gluteus-maximus__cue-2.text: In Bridge, keep the glutes working but not clenched.

deep-rotators__cue-2.text: Rotate your front thigh out as you fold.

hip-adductors__cue-3.text: In Prasarita, draw your inner thighs back as you fold.

quadriceps__cue-2.text: In Chair, sit back into your heels and feel your thighs working.

hip__care-pelvis.text: If your lower back is complaining, bring your hips a little higher on a blanket.

deltoids__cue-3.text: Let the arms rest; nothing to hold here.

pectoralis-major__cue-4.text: Let the front of your chest soften and spread over the bolster.

rectus-abdominis__cue-1.text: Draw your lower ribs in toward your hips.

rectus-abdominis__cue-3.text: In Sphinx, let the belly be soft and the front body long.

rectus-abdominis__cue-4.text: Knit your front ribs together as you reach up.

transversus-abdominis__cue-1.text: Draw your belly in gently to support your spine.

transversus-abdominis__cue-3.text: Hug your low belly in as you lift one leg.

iliopsoas__cue-1.text: Sink your hips forward and down, and feel the front of your back hip open.

iliopsoas__cue-4.text: In Boat, lift from deep in your hips, not just your belly.

gluteus-maximus__cue-1.text: Press into your heels and lift your hips.

gluteus-maximus__cue-3.text: Let your seat get heavy and soft; sink toward the floor.

gluteus-maximus__cue-4.text: Squeeze your seat gently to protect your lower back in the backbend.

gluteus-medius__cue-1.text: Keep your hips level; don’t let the standing hip push out.

gluteus-medius__cue-2.text: Press the outer edge of your back foot down and feel the side of your hip wake up.

gluteus-medius__cue-3.text: In Shoelace, breathe into the outer hip.

piriformis__cue-1.text: You should feel this deep in your outer hip, not in your knee.

piriformis__cue-2.text: Find your edge and let the hip soften a little more with each exhale.

piriformis__cue-3.text: Flex your front foot to protect the knee as the hip opens.

deep-rotators__cue-1.text: Let the thighs roll open from deep in the hip sockets.

hip-adductors__cue-1.text: Squeeze the block between your thighs.

hip-adductors__cue-2.text: In Frog, let your inner thighs soften toward the floor; don’t push.

hip-adductors__cue-4.text: Let your inner thighs open as you sink into Warrior II.

quadriceps__cue-1.text: Lift your kneecaps to engage the front of your thighs.

quadriceps__cue-3.text: In Saddle, let the front of your thighs lengthen; come up if the knees complain.

quadriceps__cue-4.text: Press through your front foot and feel the front of your thigh working.

hamstrings__cue-1.text: Bend your knees as much as you need to keep your back long.

hamstrings__cue-2.text: Lift your sitting bones toward the ceiling in Downward Dog.

hamstrings__cue-3.text: In Caterpillar, let your back round and the backs of your legs soften.

hamstrings__cue-4.text: Fold from your hips, not from your waist.

it-band__cue-1.text: Cross your knees and let the outer thighs release.

it-band__cue-2.text: In Eagle, hug your thighs together and feel the outer hips.

sacrum__cue-1.text: Let your sacrum feel heavy toward the floor.

sacrum__cue-2.text: In Bridge, slide a block under your sacrum, not your lower back.

tailbone__cue-1.text: Lengthen your tailbone toward your heels.

tailbone__cue-2.text: Tuck your tailbone slightly in Warrior I.

tailbone__cue-3.text: Let your tailbone drop and the lower back widen.

pelvis__cue-1.text: Keep your hips level, like a bowl of water you don’t want to spill.

pelvis__cue-2.text: Square your hips to the front of the mat.

pelvis__cue-3.text: Let the pelvis settle; there’s nothing to hold.

sit-bones__cue-1.text: Root down through your sitting bones and lengthen up.

sit-bones__cue-2.text: Lift your sitting bones toward the ceiling in Downward Dog.

sit-bones__cue-3.text: Sit on the edge of a blanket so your sitting bones can tip forward.

hip-joint__cue-1.text: Hinge at your hips, not your waist.

hip-joint__cue-3.text: Turn your thigh out from the hip socket, not the knee.

knee__cue-1.text: Keep your knee tracking over your second toe.

knee__cue-2.text: Stack your knee over your ankle, not past it.

knee__cue-3.text: If you feel anything sharp in the knee, come out of the pose.

knee__cue-4.text: Keep a micro-bend; don’t lock your knees.

ankle__cue-1.text: Stack your knee over your ankle.

ankle__cue-2.text: Flex your ankle and point your toes toward your face.

ankle__cue-3.text: In Toe Squat, go gently; the ankles and toes open slowly.

shoulder-joint__cue-1.text: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.

shoulder-joint__cue-2.text: Stack your shoulders over your wrists.

warrior-2__cue-2.text: Turn your right toes out, and your left toes in slightly.

warrior-2__cue-4.text: Press into the outer edge of your back foot.

warrior-2__cue-5.text: Reach your arms out wide, parallel to the floor.
